ideas.text:
a single html page with no external libraries for reading compiled projects. 

it sits next to the project folders. projects.json is an object with one key, projects, the list of project names. it reads projects.json and shows one card per project.

each project folder holds two json files. ideas.json holds an object with one key, ideas, the list of ideas. code.json holds an object with one key, code, the list of code lines.

every idea and every code line has an id, a text and a source, the ids of the ideas that caused it. 

the root idea I0 has no source. I0 does not show in the lists. clicking a project card opens it.

the ideas sit on the left, one row per idea with its id and its text.

the code sits on the right with line numbers, one row per code line. 

ideas and code lines are one graph through the source arrays. 

clicking a node selects it and highlights its flow. the selected node shows a strong color. the other nodes in the flow show a lighter color. the highlight colors are light and soft. the ids and the line numbers stay easy to read on every highlight color.

the flow is the node, its sources followed up the chain to I0, and every idea and code line that reaches the node through its source chain. the descendants of the sources are not part of the flow. only the clicked node gives descendants.

rows outside the flow collapse into one row of three dots with the count of hidden rows. 

clicking the selected node again or clicking empty space clears the selection and shows every row again. 

hovering a node colors its flow but does not collapse the rows and does not move the rows. only a click collapses the rows. the page keeps the same look in light and dark mode.
a single html page with no external libraries
it sits next to the project folders
projects.json is an object with one key, projects, the list of project names
it reads projects.json and shows one card per project
each project folder holds two json files
ideas.json holds an object with one key, ideas, the list of ideas
code.json holds an object with one key, code, the list of code lines
every idea and every code line has an id, a text and a source, the ids of the ideas that caused it
the root idea I0 has no source. I0 does not show in the lists
clicking a project card opens it
the ideas sit on the left, one row per idea with its id and its text
the code sits on the right with line numbers, one row per code line
ideas and code lines are one graph through the source arrays
clicking a node selects it and highlights its flow
the selected node shows a strong color
the other nodes in the flow show a lighter color
the highlight colors are light and soft
the ids and the line numbers stay easy to read on every highlight color
the flow is the node, its sources followed up the chain to I0, and every idea and code line that reaches the node through its source chain
the descendants of the sources are not part of the flow. only the clicked node gives descendants
rows outside the flow collapse into one row of three dots with the count of hidden rows
clicking the selected node again or clicking empty space clears the selection and shows every row again
hovering a node colors its flow but does not collapse the rows and does not move the rows
only a click collapses the rows
the page keeps the same look in light and dark mode
fetch projects.json from the same directory using a relative path
for each project name in projects, create a card element and append it to the page
fetch ideas.json and code.json from the project subfolder by name
when a project card is clicked, fetch its data and switch the view to show the two-column layout
the page has two states: project list view and project detail view
render the left column by iterating over ideas, skipping any idea with id I0, one div per idea showing id and text
render the right column by iterating over code lines, one div per line showing line number and text
line numbers are 1-based indices of the code array
assign a data-id attribute to every rendered idea row and code row so they can be looked up by id
build an in-memory map from each node id to its source array after loading
build an in-memory reverse map from each node id to the list of node ids that directly list it in their source
attach click listeners to every idea row and code row
attach mouseover and mouseout listeners to every idea row and code row for hover highlighting
track a currently selected node id in a module-level variable, null when nothing is selected
compute the flow set for a given node id: ancestors by walking source arrays up to I0, the node itself, and descendants only of the clicked node by walking the reverse map downward
ancestors are all nodes reachable by recursively following source arrays from the node up to but not including I0
descendants of the clicked node are all nodes reachable by recursively following the reverse map from the clicked node downward
when clicking a node that is not the selected node, set it as selected, compute its flow, apply strong color to the node, lighter color to the rest of the flow, and collapse rows outside the flow
when clicking the already selected node, clear selection and restore all rows
attach a click listener to the page background that clears selection when the click target is not a node row
to collapse rows outside the flow: remove individual rows from the DOM and insert a single placeholder div showing ... and the hidden count in their place, grouped by contiguous hidden runs
each column handles its own collapse runs independently
to restore all rows: remove all placeholder divs and re-insert all row divs in order
on hover, add highlight classes to the flow rows without touching the DOM structure
on mouseout, remove hover highlight classes from all rows
hover highlighting is suppressed while a node is selected so hover does not override selection colors
use three CSS classes: node-selected for the clicked node, node-flow for other flow members, node-hover for hover flow members
node-selected background is a saturated but not harsh color, node-flow background is a pale tint of the same hue
node-hover background is a pale neutral tint distinct from node-flow
all highlight background colors have sufficient contrast with black text so ids and numbers remain readable
use a CSS media query for prefers-color-scheme dark to redefine the highlight colors so text contrast is preserved in dark mode
in dark mode, the page background and default text colors flip to dark background and light text
all CSS is written inside a style tag in the single html file
all JavaScript is written inside a script tag in the single html file
the two-column layout uses CSS flexbox or grid with the left column and right column side by side
each column is independently scrollable
the project list view shows a grid or wrapping row of clickable project cards
a back button or link in the detail view returns to the project list view
switching views clears any active selection and resets all highlights
node ids from ideas.json and code.json are treated as strings throughout for map keys and attribute values
the source field of a node is an array of id strings; iterate it when building ancestor and descendant sets
guard against cycles in the graph when computing ancestors and descendants by tracking visited ids
